Services

Two offerings,
one institution.

Software that runs the school day, and identity cards that make it official. Each is a separate craft; both are built around how your institution works.

School management software

The school day, in one system.

Student records, attendance, fees, grades, and communications live in one place. Front-office staff, teachers, and administrators each get a view that matches their day.

Records and attendance

Student and staff records, daily attendance, and grades. Teachers mark attendance from the classroom; absences surface instantly for the front office.

Fees without the paperwork

Fee structures, invoices, receipts, and reminders in one ledger. Staff see who has paid at a glance, and families get clear statements.

Messages that reach parents

Announcements, circulars, and urgent alerts go out by SMS and notification. Delivery is tracked, so the school knows what was seen.

ID-card printing

A card that feels official.

Durable PVC cards carrying your institution's identity, printed and finished to a professional standard. Sample designs shown; every card is made to order.

Your identity, printed

Institution name, logo, and student or staff details on every card. Your artwork, your data.

A professional finish

Crisp printing on durable PVC with clean edges. Every card is checked before it ships.

Made to order

Cards are produced for your institution in the quantities you need, with lanyards available.
